host.description: The hostname or domain to update (e.g., example.dyndns.org or 'all.dnsomatic.com' for all registered IPs)

plugin_option.description: Additional plugin-specific option string (e.g., 'hostname' for some plugins)

user.description: Username for the DNS service (often email address or API username)

password.description: Password or API token for the DNS service (required for most plugins)

interface.description: Local IP address the web interface should bind to (e.g., 127.0.0.1 for localhost only)

port.description: Port number for the internal web interface (use 0 to disable)

log_level.description: Minimum log level: debug, info, warning, error, or critical

log_file.description: Path to log file (set to empty string to disable file logging)

foreground.description: Run in foreground (true) or as a background daemon (false)

interval.description: Update interval in seconds (only used in daemon mode)

use_tls.description: Enable TLS/SSL for the web interface (requires valid cert/key)

ssl_key.description: Path to TLS private key file

cache_dns.description: Enable DNS caching to reduce lookups

webhooks.description: List of HTTP(S) webhook URLs to call on update success or failure

plugin_config.description: Plugin-specific configuration as key-value pairs (passed unmodified to plugin)
